releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.51 — notifications, finally. A message from someone else now rings the phone with a proper WhatsApp-style notification: one channel per chat (so Android's own settings can mute a single person or group), the last few lines stacked with the sender's name, a tap that opens that exact conversation, and Reply directly from the shade — the answer is queued through the same outbox the composer uses, so it still sends when the phone is offline. A muted chat arrives silently, the chat you are looking at never rings at you, and opening a chat clears its notification. Android 13 asks for the notification permission on first launch. Includes 1.0.49's swipe-to-reply, double-tap ❤️ and voice speed, and 1.0.50's in-chat search, multi-select, starred messages, drafts and photo viewer.
